headline: Committee takes up Bill 9 phase-out dates, sends resort question to TIG

meeting.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meeting.voteItem: Motion to convene an executive session under section 92-5(a)(4), Hawaiʻi Revised Statutes
meeting.summary: Staff said the committee amended the phase-out dates to set a separate period for West Maui. The question of excluding resort properties will go to the TIG, and the administration said it would work with the council on a path for owners to seek rezoning.
meeting.recap: Members moved and seconded a motion to recommend passing Bill 9 on first reading.[[0:37:30]] The committee voted to meet in executive session (a closed-door meeting) with its attorneys.[[0:59:54]] A member proposed ending the phase-out on December 31, 2028 in West Maui and December 31, 2030 elsewhere.[[1:23:08]] A member said the fire removed a lot of West Maui's housing.[[1:25:24]] The administration said it would work with the council on a path for owners to seek rezoning.[[2:00:00]] The substitute version, as amended, passed with nine ayes.[[2:17:04]]
decided: A motion to exempt timeshares and uses allowed under a variance was moved and seconded, with no vote heard in the recording.
The committee voted by voice to go into executive session with its attorneys.
Staff said the committee amended the phase-out dates to set a separate period for West Maui.
meeting.next: A member reminded colleagues they can still raise items at first reading. A member said a TIG will need to work on the issues not covered in this bill. The question of excluding resort properties will go to the TIG. Staff will make a remaining July 1, 2030 deadline in the bill match the new phase-out dates, with the body's agreement.

deadlines.t: End of the phase-out period in the West Maui Community Plan area, as proposed.

issues.brief: The proposal ended the phase-out on December 31, 2028 in the West Maui Community Plan area.[[#1]] A member said some people who live and work in West Maui may sit in traffic four or more hours a day.[[#2]] A member said the Maui Planning Commission recommended a shorter period for West Maui.[[#3]] A member said the mayor's presentation estimated it would take 73 years to build 2,200 homes in Lahaina.[[#4]]
